mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening labor markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In a labor market strengthening regime, the 5-day forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE trending downward.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDP (GDPC1) growth indicates expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In an expanding economy, the 60-day forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 trending upward.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the supply index (INDPRO) signals tight labor markets or supply constraints, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In a tight labor markets regime, the 5-day forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% during a tightening cycle signals contractionary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In a monetary tightening cycle, the 20-day forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained fall in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In a robust labor market, the 60-day forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 19,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In a strong economic growth regime, the 5-day forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 crossing above 19,000.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) creates a favorable environment for growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases AND UNRATE falls below 4.0%
failure_condition: In a monetary easing cycle, the 20-day forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the combined decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals contractionary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In a monetary tightening cycle, the 60-day forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 1.5%.
